name: cmd_photo_setCaptureTime
description: Edit Capture Time (command `photo.setCaptureTime`). Params: {ids?, time?: `2026-09-30T14:05:00` (the active photo gets it, the others shift by the same amount), each?: bool (every photo gets `time`), shift?: seconds, hours?: time-zone shift in hours} → {changed, captured: [..]}.
